public_rationale: The proposed cause is not established. limitations: No decisive causal evidence item was found.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Sora produces anatomical errors such as six-fingered humans and four-legged ants because it has no underlying model of physiological structure.

statement.excerpt: You also wind up with humans with six fingers, humans with three arms, weird walking gaits, ants with four legs, etc because there is no underlying model of the physiological structure of an ant or a human being.

from_speaker: because there is no underlying model of the physiological structure
our_interpretation: The claim attributes anatomical errors to an absence of internal anatomical representation, rather than merely reporting that errors occur.
Underlying model includes learned representations; the wording does not restrict it to an explicitly programmed anatomical template.
The target is the February 2024 research-preview snapshot, the latest publicly documented version before the post.
criteria.support_condition: Version-matched evidence verifies anatomical errors and causally links them to the absence of anatomical representations, rather than merely showing that no explicit anatomy module was disclosed.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Controlled evidence shows that relevant anatomical representations exist and that the cited errors arise from another mechanism, undermining the asserted explanation.
